content:
Hi Charalampos,

Thanks for the screenshot. The important part is “User is authenticated but not connected”, which means the authentication itself is succeeding, but Thunderbird is unable to establish the mail connection afterwards.

Because you imported the settings from Thunderbird on your laptop, could you check whether the account is using IMAP or POP? In Thunderbird for Android, go to Settings > your account > Fetching mail > Incoming server.

Could you also tell us which email provider you use and the incoming server name shown there?

If the account is using POP with OAuth2, that is particularly important, as Thunderbird for Android does not currently support OAuth2 authentication for POP accounts. In that case, switching the account to IMAP would be the preferred solution if your provider supports it.

If you're already using IMAP, the provider and server name should help narrow this down.
